answer: A river carries only what is already in it, so credit must trace upstream. Each identity needs two holders outside its own bank to countersign its claim, and one countersignature backs one identity, so n aliases need n distinct witnesses rather than a single ring. Every claim is priced by rank: the k-th filing an operator submits costs k squared in bond, so a farm pays near n cubed while still needing unrelated guarantors. At dawn an audit replays a random claim; each sealed record carries an onyx token that cannot be pooled or resold, and an unconfirmed claim forfeits its bond.
